name: United Club℠ Visa Infinite Card

welcome_offer.description: Earn up to 100,000 bonus miles: 90,000 bonus miles after you spend $5,000 on purchases in the first 3 months, plus 10,000 bonus miles after you add an authorized user in the first 3 months.

earning_rates.notes: 11x total miles on eligible United flights (includes MileagePlus member miles)
5x miles on all other eligible United purchases
5x miles on prepaid hotel stays through Renowned Hotels and Resorts for United Cardmembers
2x miles on dining including eligible delivery services

other_benefits.name: United Club Membership
other_benefits.description: United Club all-access membership — unlimited entry to United Club lounges worldwide and Star Alliance lounges when flying United or partners

other_benefits.name: Two Free Checked Bags
other_benefits.description: First 2 checked bags free for cardmember and companions on the same reservation (saves $80-160 round trip)

other_benefits.name: Premier Access
other_benefits.description: Full Premier Access travel services: priority check-in, security, boarding, and baggage handling

other_benefits.name: Global Entry/TSA PreCheck
other_benefits.description: Up to $120 credit for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck every 4 years

other_benefits.name: Award Flash Sales
other_benefits.description: Cardmember-only United MileagePlus award flash sales

other_benefits.name: Expanded Award Availability
other_benefits.description: Access to expanded United MileagePlus award availability

other_benefits.name: PQP Earnings
other_benefits.description: Earn up to 10,000 Premier Qualifying Points (PQP) per year (500 PQP per $12,000 spent)

sources.notes: Official Chase page checked 2026-10-02: $695 annual fee; up to 100,000 bonus miles (90k after $5,000 in 3 months + 10k for adding an authorized user); 11x/5x/5x/2x/2x/1x earning.

notes: Ultra-premium United card with full United Club access ($650+ value alone). $695 AF (increased from $525 in 2025). Total annual credits (Instacart $300 + Streaming $120 + Rideshare $150 = $570) significantly offset the AF for those who use them. PQP earnings (up to 10,000/year) can fast-track United 1K elite status. Primary competitor is United Club Business Card. Both are essentially the same card (Club membership) — personal version vs business version.

recurring_credits.name: Renowned Hotels & Resorts Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $200/year statement credit on prepaid bookings through Renowned Hotels and Resorts via Chase Travel.

recurring_credits.name: Avis/Budget TravelBank Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $100/year ($50 per rental, up to 2 rentals) in United TravelBank cash for eligible Avis and Budget rentals booked through cars.united.com.

recurring_credits.name: Rideshare Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $150/year in rideshare credits, distributed monthly ($12 Jan-Nov, $18 Dec).

recurring_credits.name: Instacart Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $20/month (2x $10) in Instacart+ credits when paying with the card. Includes complimentary Instacart+ membership through Dec 31, 2027.

recurring_credits.name: DoorDash Non-Restaurant Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $10 off one qualifying non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter (DashMart, 7-Eleven, CVS, Safeway, etc.). Requires active DashPass enrollment. Per Chase cobrand-doordash terms.

recurring_credits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $100 statement credit for Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or NEXUS application fee, every 4 years.
